baseRelease: Windows RC21 uses the exact-one-page encrypted Messages candidate and the published RC20 unsigned Test installer as its upgrade baseline. Its changed shared helper requires fresh runtime, frozen-worker and package qualification.
runtime: Windows x64 CPython 3.12.10 with matching bundled Tcl/Tk, matching accepted rc17 native/source closure; frozen helper and window runtimes are separate
reviewProtocol: 200-contact searchable preview pages, cross-page selected IDs, 1000-ID review pages with exact UUID and SHA-256 selection binding; browser v2 immutable source pages and verified saved ACK remain in the shared engine
wrapperOnedir: dist/AmplifaiPhone/{AmplifaiPhone.exe,_internal/}; external resources/ staged beside the wrapper executable, not inside wrapper _internal/
helperOnedir: dist/AmplifaiPhoneHelper/{AmplifaiPhoneHelper.exe,_internal/}; copy the entire matching tree without flattening into wrapper resources/phone-helper/
resourceChecks: frozen-only fixed paths, no symlink/reparse resource entries, readable contained runtime; shape checks do not replace build/hash/signature qualification
childRuntime: fixed helper executable with helper-directory cwd, private stdin/stdout, discarded stderr, shell=false, fresh copied env without PYTHONPATH/PYTHONHOME and PYINSTALLER_RESET_ENVIRONMENT=1

resources.contract: entire matching frozen AmplifaiPhoneHelper onedir including AmplifaiPhoneHelper.exe and its matching _internal/; not an isolated copied executable or source/PATH fallback
exact COPYRIGHT, LICENSE and THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt byte hashes from the candidate source root

install: WiX 3 per-user limited-privilege MSI to LocalAppDataFolder with HKCU amplifai-phone setup URI registration. Windows remains unsigned Test; physical PC/SmartScreen/driver/iPhone and real account acceptance are separate evidence.
releaseGates: complete matching helper runtime/dependency hashes and driver qualification
windowProtocol: Account-bound native setup v2 claims the fixed HTTPS authority, displays the exact Windows disclosure and account/course, records explicit approval, then requires separate Start admission before collection. Selection is editable until deliberate Continue; the first immutable bind attempt freezes the exact selection/handoff/digest for identical retry or cancellation. Verified browser intent and Save/readback ACK remain required. Existing legacy handoff keeps its separate destination and Save decisions. Source coverage and bounded diagnostics remain distinct from received/transferred/saved state.
updateDependency: Existing hash-pinned cryptography==50.0.1; no new dependency or lock change
updateProtocol: Fixed HTTPS signed exact-byte manifest; bounded matching GitHub MSI bytes verified by length/SHA256/Ed25519. Explicit live-idle action copies matching frozen helper/runtime using build-time embedded hash inventory. Helper independently verifies persisted signed manifest/MSI, pins runtime/cache/MSI, signals ready, requires explicit commit/EOF and normal parent exit, then launches normal Windows Installer UI and holds guards through exit. No app-path locks during replacement, no shell/quiet runtime, unsigned TEST label retained.
bootstrapInventory: build_windows_candidate.py freezes helper first; exact helper onedir path/byte/SHA256 records are compiled into wrapper-only _windows_update_bootstrap Python module before wrapper freeze. No source/system Python fallback.
nativeSetupDelivery: Strict one-URI launch grammar; a bounded current-logon protected first-instance named pipe forwards to the existing Tk owner. Plain launch advertises read-only schema2 capabilities only when delivery is owned. Same-logon routing is not package attestation or collection authority.
